items.source: inboundChannel - the channel for receiving messages from clients (for example, WebSocket clients)
items.translation: inboundChannel - 用于接收来自客户端（例如，WebSocket 客户端）消息的通道。

items.source: outboundChannel - the channel for sending messages to clients (for example, WebSocket clients)
items.translation: outboundChannel - 用于向客户端（例如，WebSocket 客户端）发送消息的通道

items.source: brokerChannel - the channel for the application to send messages to the broker
items.translation: brokerChannel - 应用程序向代理发送消息的通道

items.source: The LifecycleProcessor will call only this variant of the stop method; i.e. Lifecycle.stop() will not be called for SmartLifecycle implementations unless explicitly delegated to within the implementation of this method.
items.translation: `LifecycleProcessor` 将仅调用此版本的 `stop` 方法；即，除非在该方法的实现中显式委托，否则不会为 `SmartLifecycle` 实现调用 `Lifecycle.stop()`。

items.source: A value of false indicates that the component is intended to be started through an explicit Lifecycle.start() call instead, analogous to a plain Lifecycle implementation.
items.translation: 值为 `false` 表示该组件旨在通过显式的 Lifecycle.start() 调用启动，类似于普通的 Lifecycle 实现。

items.source: The provided callback is used by the LifecycleProcessor to support an ordered, and potentially concurrent, shutdown of all components having a common shutdown order value. The callback must be executed after the SmartLifecycle component does indeed stop.
items.translation: 提供的回调由LifecycleProcessor使用，以支持具有公共关闭顺序值的所有组件的有序且可能并发的关闭。该回调必须在SmartLifecycle 组件确实停止后执行。

items.source: By default, this is SmartLifecycle.DEFAULT_PHASE, but with @EnableWebSocketMessageBroker configuration it is set to 0.
items.translation: 默认情况下，这是SmartLifecycle.DEFAULT_PHASE，但在使用@EnableWebSocketMessageBroker配置时，它被设置为 0。

items.source: Note that this is in addition to the isRunning() flag, which indicates whether this message handler is running. In other words the message handler must first be running and then the #isBrokerAvailable() flag may still independently alternate between being on and off depending on the concrete subclass implementation.
items.translation: 请注意，这除了 `isRunning()` 标志之外（该标志指示此消息处理器是否正在运行），换句话说，消息处理器必须首先处于运行状态，然后 `#isBrokerAvailable()` 标志仍可能根据具体子类的实现独立地在开启和关闭之间切换。

items.source: When this flag is set to true messages within the same session will be sent to the "clientOutboundChannel" one at a time in order to preserve the order of publication.
items.translation: 当此标志设置为 `true` 时，同一会话中的消息将按顺序逐个发送到 `"clientOutboundChannel"`，以保持发布顺序。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to Lifecycle.stop() and immediately triggers the given callback in the calling thread. Note that there is no synchronization between the two, so custom implementations may at least want to put the same steps within their common lifecycle monitor (if any).
items.translation: 默认实现会委托给 Lifecycle.stop()，并立即在调用线程中触发给定的回调。请注意，这两者之间没有同步机制，因此自定义实现至少应该将其中的相同步骤放在其公共生命周期监视器（如果有）内。

items.source: Note that even when this message handler is running the isBrokerAvailable() flag may still independently alternate between being on and off depending on the concrete subclass implementation.
items.translation: 请注意，即使此消息处理器正在运行，`isBrokerAvailable()` 标志仍可能根据具体子类实现独立地在开启和关闭之间切换。

items.source: By default messages sent to the "clientOutboundChannel" may not be processed in the same order because the channel is backed by a ThreadPoolExecutor that in turn does not guarantee processing in order.
items.translation: 默认情况下，发送到 `"clientOutboundChannel"` 的消息可能不会按顺序处理，因为该通道由 `ThreadPoolExecutor` 支持，而后者无法保证按顺序处理。

items.source: Application components may implement org.springframework.context.ApplicationListener<BrokerAvailabilityEvent> to receive notifications when broker becomes available and unavailable.
items.translation: 应用程序组件可以实现 org.springframework.context.ApplicationListener<BrokerAvailabilityEvent> 以接收有关代理可用和不可用的通知。

items.source:
Whether a message with the given destination should be processed. This is the case if one of the following conditions is true:
  1. The destination starts with one of the configured destination prefixes.
  2. No prefixes are configured and the destination isn't matched by the userDestinationPredicate.
  3. The message has no destination.
items.translation:
是否应处理具有给定目的地的消息。如果满足以下条件之一，则进行处理：
  1. 目的地以配置的某个destination prefixes开头。
  2. 未配置任何前缀，且目的地未被userDestinationPredicate匹配。
  3. 消息没有目的地。

items.source: Returns true if this Lifecycle component should get started automatically by the container at the time that the containing ApplicationContext gets refreshed or restarted.
items.translation: 如果此 `Lifecycle` 组件应在包含的 ApplicationContext 刷新或重启时自动启动，则返回 `true`。

items.source: Configure a Predicate to identify messages with a user destination. When no destination prefixes are configured, this helps to recognize and skip user destination messages that need to be pre-processed by the UserDestinationMessageHandler before they reach the broker.
items.translation: 配置一个 Predicate 以识别具有用户目的地的消息。当未配置任何 目的地前缀 时，这有助于识别并跳过需要由 UserDestinationMessageHandler 在到达代理之前进行预处理的 用户目的地消息。

items.source: The default implementation returns SmartLifecycle.DEFAULT_PHASE in order to let stop() callbacks execute before regular Lifecycle implementations.
items.translation: 默认实现返回SmartLifecycle.DEFAULT_PHASE，以便在常规的Lifecycle实现之前执行stop()回调。

items.source: The default implementation returns true.
items.translation: 默认实现返回true。

items.source: Note that this stop notification is not guaranteed to come before destruction: On regular shutdown, Lifecycle beans will first receive a stop notification before the general destruction callbacks are being propagated; however, on hot refresh during a context's lifetime or on aborted refresh attempts, a given bean's destroy method will be called without any consideration of stop signals upfront.
items.translation: 请注意，此停止通知并不保证在销毁之前发出： 在常规关闭过程中，Lifecycle 圈会先接收停止通知，然后再传播通用的销毁回调；然而，在上下文生命周期期间的热刷新或中止的刷新尝试中，给定 bean 的销毁方法将在不考虑任何预先停止信号的情况下被调用。

items.source: By default this is not set.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此项未设置。

items.source:
Invoked after population of normal bean properties but before an init
callback like InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet or a custom init-method.
Invoked before ApplicationContextAware's setApplicationContext.
items.translation: 在普通 Bean 属性填充之后、但早于初始化回调（如 InitializingBean 的 afterPropertiesSet 或自定义 init-method）之前被调用。在 ApplicationContextAware 的 setApplicationContext 之前被调用。

items.source: Should not throw an exception if the component is already running.
items.translation: 如果组件已经在运行，则不应抛出异常。

items.source:
In the case of a container, this will propagate a hard start signal to all
components that apply, even to non-auto-startup components.
items.translation: 对于容器而言，这将向所有适用的组件传播硬启动信号，即使包括非自动启动的组件。

items.source: Should not throw an exception if the component is not running (not started yet).
items.translation: 如果组件尚未运行（尚未启动），则不应抛出异常。

items.source:
In the case of a container, this will propagate the stop signal to all components
that apply.
items.translation: 对于容器，这将向所有适用的组件传播停止信号。
